definitions.explanation: A casual greeting used when parting for the night or before going to bed.

examples.japanese: おやすみ、いい{夢|ゆめ}{見|み}てね。
{子供|こども}に「おやすみ」と{言|い}った。
examples.english: I said 'good night' to the child.

notes:
おやすみ is the casual form of the nighttime/bedtime greeting.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- おやすみ: casual (friends, family, children)
- おやすみなさい: polite (general use)

USAGE:
- Said before going to sleep
- Said when parting at night
- Can be used as a farewell in late evening

KANJI: From お{休|やす}み (rest). Same stem as {休|やす}む (to rest).

TEXTING: Often shortened to おやすみ〜 or おやすー in casual messages.
